entities.name: Kuba
entities.description: A former snapjaw lizard on Ravnica who, after being augmented by the Izzet and mutated by the Simic, became a thinking humanoid creature.

entities.name: Ruslan
entities.description: A boy who bought Kuba as a hatchling at Tin Street Market.

entities.name: Alena
entities.description: Owner of a dog that Kuba could probably eat.

entities.name: Kelen Jek
entities.description: An Izzet mechanoaugmentation specialist who experimented on Kuba.

entities.name: Stanisil
entities.description: A Simic biomancer of Hull Clade who nursed Kuba back to health and taught him to read and write.

entities.name: Trifon
entities.description: A Speaker to whom Stanisil wrote about Kuba.

entities.name: Tin Street Market
entities.description: Market on Ravnica where Ruslan bought Kuba.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: The guild whose Rot Farm Kuba entered and which herded him into Izzet territory.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: The guild whose specialist augmented Kuba.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: The guild whose biomancer cared for Kuba.

events.summary: Ruslan buys the snapjaw hatchling Kuba at Tin Street Market.
events.quote: Kuba was purchased at Tin Street Market by the boy Ruslan

events.summary: Kuba runs into the sewer and ends up in a Golgari Rot Farm, eating workers; the Golgari herd it into Izzet territory.
events.quote: To get rid of it, the Golgari herded Kuba into Izzet territory.

events.summary: Kelen Jek augments Kuba with a mizzium framework and a neuroamplification serum, enhancing cognition and skeleton.
events.quote: which resulted in both enhanced cognition as well as a reinforced skeletal system

events.summary: Kuba escapes into Simic territory, where Stanisil nurses him back to health and an unexpected mutation expands his intellect.
events.quote: The biomancer Stanisil of Hull Clade found Kuba in this state and nursed it back to health.

events.summary: Kuba becomes fully sapient and learns to read and write under Stanisil.
events.quote: Kuba eventually developed sapience and full intelligence.

events.summary: Kuba remembers Ruslan and resolves to return home.
events.quote: Kuba would return home and even remembered the way.

relations.quote: Kuba was purchased at Tin Street Market by the boy Ruslan

relations.note: tutored Kuba to read and write
relations.quote: Kuba eventually learned to read and write under the careful tutelage of the biomancer
the Izzet mechanoaugmentation specialist Kelen Jek
